correctness.rationale: For a transitive tournament, all allowed paths are strictly increasing subsets and the primitive cube-root deletion differential d obeys d³=0. The augmented subset complex is E^{⊗_ω n}, with explicit bar tensor identities B1⊗E=B2, B2⊗E=B3⊕B1 and B3⊗E=B3⊕B3, giving exactly one short central bar and one B3 starting in degree zero. Modding out the empty subset converts that B3 into a B2 and yields the additive parity-dependent Kronecker Betti expressions in both q=1,2. Removing 1→n excludes one degree-one path; allowed d-invariant subspaces in degrees 2 and 3 are the respective kernels of missing-edge coefficient after d and d². For n≥4, x=(1,2,3,n) gives a nonzero λ(d²x)=1+ω²=-ω and its three-element bar splits the quotient, so all Mayer groups are invariant. Independently built exact q-boundary matrices mod 7 and verified both Betti profiles n=2..8, not a proof for all n or over C.
